coordinate_system: x right, y down; all full-canvas production layers share origin [0,0]
reference_state: Mac observation brief received; actual pixel transfer pending
scope: Original composition/layer plan only; no source layout copying, no new image assets or runtime implementation

render_contract.style: Detailed naturalistic square-pixel clusters, connected organic shape groups, stepped silhouettes, restrained hue ramps; calm broad atmosphere with selective foreground detail.
render_contract.light: Soft upper-left light, consistent cast-shadow direction toward lower-right.
render_contract.depth: Far planes lower contrast and cooler; nearby forms darker with selective restrained warm highlights.
render_contract.bird_focus: Keep a broad continuous open ground stage. No birds, feeders, baths, furniture, text or UI baked into these layers.

name: Oak shade pocket with an off-center garden opening
regional_fit: Conditional San Diego oak/riparian-influenced yard edge with shade and moisture access. Evergreen oak plus dry-to-damp managed garden ground; no tropical understory or universal stream assumption.
original_design_choices: An intimate domestic clearing seen toward an understated low stone boundary; no lake, boat, mountain-valley or waterfall composition.
One near oak trunk cropped at far left, a smaller offset right canopy fragment, and a pale irregular opening displaced slightly right of center.
Broad central buff-gray shaded ground with fine texture reserved for contact readability; scattered oak litter remains peripheral.
Vegetation varies in height with visible branching gaps; no uniform hedge band or symmetric arch.

composition_regions.role: Low-contrast luminous distance, with no bright center focal object.
Clear continuous ground; provisional placement area, not collision geometry.
Dark edge frame restricted to extreme left.
Sparse low near accent, central ground remains open.

layers.contents: Pale sky glimpses and broad cool desaturated distant canopy masses; lower half simple quiet underpaint to be covered by ground plate.
layers.motion_metadata_only: Whole distant layer could receive future parallax; no separate cloud or canopy animation asserted.

layers.contents: Low stone edge with broken peripheral planting, continuous shaded soil/decomposed-granite ground, peripheral oak litter, subtle damp margin only at one side.
layers.integration_rule: Align untrimmed canvas origin; inspect alpha holes and edge seam before acceptance.

layers.contents: Left rooted oak trunk with modest upper-left branch, sparse bottom-left litter/stone edge and smaller bottom-right understory fringe.
layers.limitations: Whole foliage/wood frame remains flattened unless future generation separates them.

seasonal_constraints: Evergreen oak does not become a full orange fall canopy.
Dampness is conditional on recent moisture/access, not generic riparian scenery across dry slopes.
